user.title: Grid and house
user.description: Pick the power sensors for grid and house. At least grid import, grid combined or house consumption is required. Combined sensors are signed, separate ones report positive values.

storage.title: Solar and storage
storage.description: Optional: solar production and storage. Multiple sensors per field are summed.

data.battery_grid_charge: Storage charged from grid (optional, part of “To storage”)

energy.title: Energy counters
energy.description: Optional: cumulative kWh counters or utility meters for the Balance tab, several per field are summed. If the Energy dashboard of Home Assistant is set up, its counters are suggested here; change or remove them as you like.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Optional: name patterns with * as wildcard, e.g. *_power. Every power sensor whose name matches is listed on the Power tab. You can also add single sensors. Exclude patterns and excluded sensors keep unwanted sensors out of the list.

data.device_exclude: Excluded sensors (never added by a pattern)
data.area_ids: Areas (their power sensors are summed up per area, none = all areas)
data.label_ids: Labels (their power sensors are summed up per label)

pv.title: PV Assistant detected
pv.description: PV Assistant is installed. Take over its sensors ({summary}) as defaults? You can still change everything in the next steps.

data.use_pv: Take over the sensors of PV Assistant

error.no_source: Please provide grid import, grid combined or house consumption.
error.invalid_pattern: Only letters, digits, _ . * and ? are allowed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Assistant is already set up.
